title: Group participation
enabledHelp: Master switch for all groups managed by this plugin.
dryRunHelp: Only record decisions; do not send replies.
liveWarning: Trial mode is off. Eligible group messages can trigger real replies.
resetConfirm: Restore parent settings for this scope?
unsavedHelp: Changing scope will discard your edits.
noGroupsHelp: You can set global or channel defaults first. Groups appear after a conversation with the bot.
agentOverride: This agent has its own overrides, which take priority over group settings.
channelDisabled: The channel is disabled. Save settings now and enable it later.
policyUnknown: Start the channel to confirm its group message visibility.
visibilityWarning: Enable group policy and configure full message visibility first.
channelParticipationDisabled: Enable automatic group participation in the channel settings first.
nativeAlwaysWarning: The channel normally replies to every message when the plugin or channel switch is off; use mention-only activation for a quiet fallback.
groupOptIn: This group is not opted in. Ordinary messages are skipped; save group settings to enable participation.
modelHelp: In smart mode, score a small amount of group context. Fall back to local rules when disabled, unavailable, or timed out.
modelOffHelp: Local rules currently apply. Enable this switch to show decision model options.
modelUnsupported: This host does not support decision model integration. Update Octop; local rules currently apply.
smartHelp: After relevance passes the threshold, sample by participation probability to decide whether to participate.
blockedTermsHelp: Matching group messages, including mentions, stop further channel processing, even in trial mode.
blockedTermsMediaHelp: Type to search; click Add or press Enter to add. Text only; images, media and file contents are not inspected.
blockedTermsTooLong: Each term can have at most 100 characters
blockedTermsTooMany: You can add at most 5000 terms
modelUnavailable: Enable and configure Octop's decision model in model settings first. Local rules currently apply.
modelBudgetHelp: All groups share the daily model call budget. Fall back to local rules at the limit; 0 disables calls.
probabilityHelp: Sample ordinary messages that pass frequency limits.
timezone: Timezone: {{timezone}}. No automatic participation during quiet hours.
saveFailed: Could not save settings. Check the values.
delayInvalid: Minimum delay must not exceed maximum delay
loadFailed: Could not load settings. Check that the plugin is enabled and loaded.
visibilityHelp: Select all messages only after the platform authorizes receiving ordinary group messages.

reasons.mention_cooldown: The reply interval has not elapsed for this mention
reasons.blocked_term: The group message contains a blocked term and was skipped
reasons.input_filter_unavailable: Blocked-term filtering is unavailable; update Gateway
reasons.group_not_allowed: This group is not opted in; ordinary message skipped
reasons.unsupported_channel: Group message metadata is unavailable; message skipped. Update the channel.
reasons.decision_model_unavailable: Decision model unavailable; using local rules
reasons.decision_model_unconfigured: Decision model not configured; using local rules
reasons.decision_model_backoff: Decision model retry paused; using local rules
reasons.decision_model_budget: Decision model budget reached; using local rules
reasons.policy_disabled: Automatic participation is off for this group
reasons.message_retracted: The message was withdrawn; this reply was cancelled.

defaultScopeHelp: Selected groups use these defaults. Options customized for a channel, group or expert take priority.
inheritanceHelp: Unchanged options follow the parent settings. Changes apply only to this scope; reset to inherit again.
promptsHelp: Inherits the selected scope. Edit individual fields, then save settings. Empty fields use the built-in text shown as a placeholder. Prefix changes do not change triggers. Keep the [NO_REPLY] silence convention in reply instructions.
promptBodyHelp: Up to 2,000 characters. The decision prompt is used only with model scoring in smart mode.
promptInvalid: Prefixes must be single-line. Prompts cannot contain NUL characters.
promptsUnsupported: Update and reload the group participation plugin to customize scene prompts.
